messages:
alana: Noticed a big cluster of SSE reconnect loops for route 'realtime-chat' in us-east around 11:04 UTC. Console shows lots of short-lived sessions + billing events. Anyone on call?

tom: saw it too. customers hitting 429s then immediately re-opening streams. believe client-js v0.9 treats 204 as connection-ok and re-subscribes instantly.

kyle: timeline looks like: proxy returns 204 (no body) when session not found, client retries immediately -> new session created -> billing event emitted -> proxy returns 204 again because of tombstone -> repeat.

meera: can you grab a short log sample? curious if the proxy is emitting FIN or just 204 then TCP close.

alana: paste: ```
[11:04:12] edge-proxy: conn_id=5632 route=realtime-chat upstream=10.8.2.3 status=204 resume_ttl=0ms
[11:04:12] edge-proxy: conn_id=5632 closed by upstream (early-close)
[11:04:12] client-js: reconnecting attempt=1 backoff=0s
[11:04:13] billing: emit event session.create id=evt_91 route=realtime-chat
```

tom: note resume_ttl=0ms is suspicious. that was changed in the canary this morning (flag resume_ttl_short=true).

kyle: if resume_ttl == 0 we tombstone immediately, which makes 204 mean 'go create a new session'. client immediate reconnect causes storm.

meera: infra-bot: show streaming session create rate delta for that window please.

infra-bot: [automated] streaming.session.creates for route "realtime-chat" increased 3.4x between 11:02 and 11:06 UTC. Unique tokens with multiple creates: 112 -> 398 in same window.

devex: flagged customers on v0.9 of client-js. we can push a patch note to recommend exponential backoff with jitter for reconnects.

alana: mitigation ideas: 1) revert resume_ttl change (quick) 2) server-side soft-204 semantics: treat 204 as soft-close and require a short grace window (e.g., 300-500ms) before allowing a session.create for that token 3) add billing idempotency key on session create to dedupe charges 4) console: show reconnect spikes and annotate with recent flag toggles.

kyle: i like server-side soft-204 + billing idempotency. clients are many and will lag. server soft-close behind rollout flag so Dedicated customers can opt-in safely.

meera: agree. also want a console alert rule: when reconnects/sec > baseline*2 && feature-flag-churn within last 15m -> alert to eng-oncall with top-5 affected tokens.

tom: quick patch: client-js v0.9.1 will add immediate backoff=100-500ms jitter for 204 responses. i'll open PR and mention server change so we don't double-patch.

console-bot: [automated] UX request captured: per-route reconnect heatmap + per-flag overlay. Ticket CON-2056.

kyle: added a small experiment for billing: add idempotency header X-Idempotency-Session when creating sessions; if duplicate within 2s, billing service will drop duplicates. put behind feature flag BILLING-DEDUPE-2026.

meera: nice. pls also include a short e2e that simulates 204->immediate-reconnect loop and asserts no more than 1 billing event per logical session.

alana: ops: i've reverted resume_ttl change in canary at 11:09 UTC. metrics are leveling off.

infra-bot: [automated] session.create rate back to 1.1x baseline by 11:14 UTC after rollback.

meera: followups & owners: - server soft-204 debounce (kyle) - billing idempotency + tests (kyle, niranjan) - client-js backoff release (tom / devex) - console reconnect heatmap + flag-overlay (josh / console team) - alert rule change (meera)

devex: i'll add a small note in streaming quickstart: "Clients should implement exponential backoff for 204/early-close responses. Server semantics may treat 204 as soft-close during rollouts."

meera: creating a short postmortem doc and scheduling 30m runbook sync. dumping incident logs & graphs into INC-924. Closing thread once actions ticketed. :white_check_mark:
